description: What the Slovak fishing act and decree say for a given day: whether all fishing is closed on trout, grayling and carp waters, the legal daily fishing hours, and which species are in their protection period. With water_id it also says which water types apply to that water. National rules only; the water's own angling rules can be stricter.

water_id.description: Optional page id of a fishing water.
